name: SpeedBLOX
desc:
🏆 Do you have what it takes to become the fastest speedrunner? 

🏃 Speedrun in over 273 unique obbies with an automatic timer, leaderboard, & replays of runs
⏰ Finish the obby as quickly as you can and check the leaderboard to see how fast you are
🏁 Race against a replay of the WR or your PB to see your pace 
🙌 Compare replays using Replay Controls to see where you can improve
💨 Invite friends to a race

Join our official group for a FREE [Fan] chat tag in-game & to receive the latest news & info!
GROUP: https://www.roblox.com/groups/9439937 

Submit an obby in the Map Testing Area, or in our communications server! 
OBBY KIT: https://www.roblox.com/library/5077394719 

✅ PRIVATE SERVERS ARE FREE!

scripts.title: World Record Holder
scripts.script:
lp=game:service("Players").LocalPlayer
char=lp.Character or lp.CharacterAdded:Wait()
root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if string.find(v.Name,"WR") then
     coroutine.wrap(function()
     while task.wait() do
      root.CFrame = v.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.4,0,-0.2) -- can change
    end
    end)()
    end
end
